dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about Nod-Krai...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: For adventurers, the vast lands of Snezhnaya should be a great place to show off their skills.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: However, there have been many factions marshaling their forces at the border as of late. Please be careful when traveling around the area.
